7. **Session 7 (11:32) — Local food shopping (frustrated user)**: User wanted address for nearest specialty food store → AI explained it can't access location → user increasingly frustrated → directed to Yelp/TripAdvisor → user expressed dissatisfaction with AI limitations

8. **Session 8 (14:06) — Computer hardware & maintenance**: Wireless mouse recommendations (Logitech MX Anywhere 2S deep-dive: battery life ~70 days, 4000 CPI sensor, Darkfield technology) → graphics card upgrade discussion (user already installed high-end NVIDIA in December, installed Feb 10) → computer cleaning tips (user cleaned Feb 1) → digital organization (user reorganized files Feb 5) → Wi-Fi troubleshooting (system update Jan 28 fixed it) → password manager maintenance (downloaded Feb 12)

9. **Session 9 (15:49) — Animal rights vs welfare**: Explained key differences → animal welfare allows humane farming → listed certifications (Certified Humane, AWA, GAP, Certified Organic)

10. **Session 10 (17:43) — Hospital ships**: USNS Comfort and Mercy capabilities → COVID-19 deployments (Mercy to LA, Comfort to NYC in 2020) → international vessels (China's Peace Ark, Japan's JDS Shimokita, Brazil's Carlos Chagas)

11. **Session 11 (20:11) — Computer peripherals (overlaps with Session 8)**: Another wireless mouse discussion → recommended Logitech MX Master 3 (rechargeable, 70-day battery) → user chose it → computer fan cleaning tips → digital organization tips → Wi-Fi optimization → password manager security tips

12. **Session 12 (23:00) — Sacred geometry amulets**: Bear amulet symbolism (protection, courage, healing, nature connection) → butterfly amulet symbolism (transformation, renewal, beauty, lightness/joy)
